name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A compact account menu: an outlined button opens a rounded dark panel with a muted heading, icon rows carrying shortcut hints, a ticked toggle row and signed-out action, all stacked with faint dividers.
use: A trigger needs to open a short list of account or row actions without leaving the page.
avoid: Rows are single-line and the panel is narrow, so long labels or dozens of actions need another pattern.
a11y: Roles and arrow-key movement come from the menu primitive, but the zoom and slide animations ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small outlined 'Open menu' button on black. Opening it shows a narrow dark rounded panel with a muted 'My account' heading, four icon rows with tiny keys on the right, a ticked 'Show status bar' row, a 'Team' row and 'Log out', split by thin rules.
behaves: Clicking the button fades and zooms in a menu just below it. Passing over a row highlights it in a slightly lighter grey; choosing a row or clicking outside closes the panel, and the tick toggles in place.
customise: You compose the label, groups, rows, dividers and shortcut hints yourself; width, inset and the destructive row styling are set per part through props and classes.
weight: light: A small portal panel that exists only while the menu is open.
